title: Minimum wage to be increased in New Zealand
summary: Шинэ Зеландад хөдөлмөрийн доод хөлс нэмэгдэх болсон, түүнд хүмүүсийн хандлага.

source.name: Wikinews
source.creditLine: Published Monday, December 18, 2006. The text of this article is licensed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 License

changes: Dateline, image, sources section and page links removed; three small grammar slips fixed ("an increase of", "is dependent on", "women").

questions.prompt: What is this news story about?
options: New Zealand’s minimum wage will go up.
New Zealand will cut workers’ holidays.
Caregivers will get free job training.
questions.explain: Эхний өгүүлбэрт "The minimum wage in New Zealand will be increased by 9.8%" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: What will the new minimum wage for adults be?
questions.explain: "NZ$11.25 per hour, an increase of $1.00 from the current wage of $10.25" гэж бичсэн. $13.66 бол Ногоон намын тооцоолсон дүн.

questions.prompt: Why is HealthCare Providers New Zealand worried?
options: Without more funding, they cannot pay higher wages.
They want the wage increase to start sooner.
They want caregivers to earn only the minimum wage.
questions.explain: Мартин Тейлор "you cannot pay out more than you are funded for" гэж хэлсэн. Засгийн газраас нэмэлт мөнгө авахгүй бол цалин нэмэх боломжгүй гэсэн үг.
